q: Which of the following errors affects the agreement of the trial balance?
e: Sales Book undercast by Rs. 2,000 — that is the right answer. This is the fact laid down for the situation described in the question. A useful way to verify this in the exam hall is to ask what would break if the opposite were true — the logic of the underlying system points straight to this option. The remaining options describe different situations or commonly confused alternatives — none of them fits the specific facts asked here. Learn the meaning rather than the option letter; examiners frequently reword this concept with shuffled choices.
